title: Emerald Saver Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: This document explains Emerald Saver APY bonuses for business credit card holders: Business Silver adds +0.12%, Business Gold adds +0.28%, and Business Platinum adds +0.52% (additive to Emerald Saver APY). It covers eligibility (same legal business entity, card open/good standing), one bonus per Emerald Saver (highest tier only), verification timing, non-retroactive interest, tier changes, and steps to link via online banking or Rho-Bank support.
